title: Unexpected token divisibility issues on non-evm chains
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The OrbitProxyOFT1_2 contract, which inherits from BaseOFTV2, uses a `_sharedDecimals` parameter in its constructor.
